fields.Name: T043 - Entity Form Code/Rich-Text Field Editor Rendering
fields.Description: Exercises the RichTextMode='code'/'markdown'/'html' rendering path (mj-code-editor, mj-markdown, CodeEditorLanguage) for long-text fields — a distinct field-type editor branch from textbox/textarea/number/date/checkbox/select and from FK search.

InputDefinition.goal: Open an entity whose records contain a large code, SQL, JSON, or markdown field via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box — good candidates are 'Templates' (template text), 'MJ: Queries' (SQL), or 'Email Templates'. Click a row and 'Open Full Record'. Locate the long code/markdown field: in read mode it should render in a formatted way (syntax-highlighted code block or rendered markdown, NOT a single plain input line). Then click Edit and confirm that field becomes a multi-line code editor (syntax-highlighted textarea) rather than a one-line text box. Success is the long/code field using the rich code-editor rendering in at least one mode. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A long code/SQL/JSON/markdown field renders with rich formatting (syntax-highlighted code editor or rendered markdown), not a plain single-line input
In edit mode the field presents as a multi-line code/rich editor
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
